units.en: Luckily, Manchukuo's National Focus tree contains all the necessary tools for uniting China. The National Focuses ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ serve to grant Manchukuo cores on all Chinese states and a wargoal against all Chinese warlords and the later National Focus ⟦2⟧ will grant wargoals against all other Chinese nations. Compared to Japan and Nationalist China, the warlords are considerably easier to conquer and should not post much of a challenge for Manchukuo. Once Manchukuo has successfully gained ownership and control of all Chinese core states, they can take the National Focus ⟦3⟧ and officially proclaim the restoration of the ⟦4⟧, thus restoring Aisin Gioro Puyi's rightful title of the Xuantong Emperor. As it reads on the lost Heirloom Seal of the Realm: ⟦5⟧, "Having received the Mandate from Heaven, may the emperor lead a long and prosperous life."
Shòumìng yú tiān jì shòu yǒngchāng

After Manchukuo has successfully unified all of China under its rule and evolved into Qing China, they will have to spend some time recovering from the endeavor and rebuilding and developing China after decades of chaos and anarchy since the fall of the Qing Dynasty in 1911. A massive industrialization program must be launched, and this will involve the mass ⟦0⟧ of more factories and dockyards, the building of infrastructure and railways, establishment of air bases and naval bases as well as reorganizing and building up the imperial military to a modern standard, to defend the realm. Qing China needs to build a modern navy and airforce, and develop an army on par with that of other major powers, and possibly even venture into the realm of special projects. In many ways, Puyi's Imperial China will be embarking on a project similar to the Great Leap Forward initiated in our timeline's by Mao's Communist China (and the later economic reforms launched by Deng Xiaoping after Mao's death), but Puyi's Imperial Revitalization has the potential to go much further and yield far greater results.

As far as industry is concerned, China's growth potential is roughly equivalent to the other great powers, with China being in possession of multiple core states with a fair number of building slots each, so there is plenty of room to build up industry in. When fully industrialized, China can easily reach over well 100 factories in total in just its own core states. When deciding which industrial format to choose, the preferred option here would be ⟦0⟧, as once the industrialization is well underway, Qing China will be able to field a proper airforce to defend its airspace and the higher production bonuses for Concentrated Industry are more useful, alongside the bonus to factory capacity in states. When it comes to the Imperial Military, the Navy and Airforce are more or less and blank slate, as Manchukuo initially did not possess either, so Qing China can choose to build up its forces from the ground up according to its own design while utilizing the newest and best available technologies.

While this national reconstruction project is ongoing, one should also begin to look abroad and take stock of the situation. Depending on how long the reconquest and reunification of China took, the game will likely now be in the early 1940s, and World War II likely well underway. This gives Qing China many possible avenues of action (once they are sufficiently prepared).
They can decide to take the fight to ⟦0⟧ and conquer them once and for all, to finish off their most immediate and long-standing rival for good.

With Japan out of the way, there is nothing stopping Qing China from imitating Japan's efforts and replicating their efforts by launching and invasion and conquest of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ and the broader Indo-Pacific region, to expel the Western powers from East- and South Asia and seize the region's resources for itself, reestablishing China's historical role as the regional hegemon. From there, China can proceed onward to Africa and the Middle East, and embark on an endeavour to carve out a colonial empire for itself. If the Europeans can do it, then Imperial China most certainly can do it as well. Successfully annex India and create a collaborationist government out of them, and Qing China will then be in control of nearly half of the world's population.
Successfully annex ⟦0⟧ and create a collaborationist government out of them, and Qing China will then be in control of nearly half of the world's population.

As a ⟦0⟧ nation, Qing China could decide to draw closer to ⟦1⟧ (particularly if they completed ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ in the⟦4⟧ branch). A fully unified fascist Imperial China is as powerful as, if not potentially even more powerful than, Germany is, and can thus potentially turn the tide of the war in the Axis powers' favor by siding with them. As part of the Axis, Qing China may finally exact vengeance on its erstwhile humiliators and carve up the world according to its own designs. Qing China can aid Germany by launching an invasion of the Soviet Union from the east, to apply additional pressure on the Russians to bring about their collapse, allowing Operation Barbarossa to succeed, inflicting a death blow to global communism. From there, the Axis Powers can turn their attention toward the Western Allies and focus their efforts on finally defeating them. This time, the perpetrators of China's Century of Humiliation shall burn! Alternatively, if still at peace with the Western Allies, then Qing China could decide to betray and backstab the Axis powers once Russia is conquered and seek to conquer them as well. This will open up the possibility of allying with the west while also being in a position to conquer all of Eastern Europe and possibly Central Europe as well, depending on how much of the Axis powers' territory China seizes compared to the Allies before the Axis are defeated. As with any fascist nation playthrough, if one's ambitions know no bounds, then there is theoretically nothing stopping Imperial China from embarking on a quest to finally make the Emperor of China the ruler of "all under heaven" both in name and in reality. Essentially a world conquest, with China united, Russia conquered and either Allied or Axis territories secured as well, Imperial China will be well positioned to continue its meteoric rise, indiscriminately invading, conquering, seizing and subjugating whatever it desires, and reshaping the entire world in its image, creating a New World Order of its own. The Sinosphere shall become global; the new Sinic world shall encompass the whole world. The Emperor of China shall become the God-Emperor of Mankind!

From there, the Axis Powers can turn their attention toward the Western Allies and focus their efforts on finally defeating them. ⟦1⟧

This will open up the possibility of allying with the west while also being in a position to conquer all of Eastern Europe and possibly Central Europe as well, depending on how much of the Axis powers' territory China seizes compared to the Allies before the Axis are defeated.

Essentially a world conquest, with China united, Russia conquered and either Allied or Axis territories secured as well, Imperial China will be well positioned to continue its meteoric rise, indiscriminately invading, conquering, seizing and subjugating whatever it desires, and reshaping the entire world in its image, creating a New World Order of its own. The Sinosphere shall become global; the new Sinic world shall encompass the whole world. The Emperor of China shall become the God-Emperor of Mankind!

Alternatively, Qing China could also instead decide to play it safe, by staying neutral, and focusing purely on building up itself and fortifying/entrenching its position, potentially siding with the Allies if threatened. If played this way, then Imperial China would at long last succeed in bringing about an end to the Century of Humiliation and emerge from the war as an equal to the Western Powers. Additionally, if active enough in the war, then China could even have a chance to gain their share of the spoils and from there become one of the leading post-war great powers, potentially even putting Qing China on the path to becoming a possible future superpower, like China eventually did historically.

Be very careful about the border with China as a sufficient push from there can easily overwhelm the player without proper assistance from Japan. China's enormous manpower pool ensures that, should the player's military be sizable and well-equipped, China can simply outlast the player in a war of attrition.

China set aside, your next biggest threat is the ⟦0⟧, as they have a National Focus that allows them to go to war with Japan and, knowing AI typical behavior, any Japanese puppet states are almost guaranteed to get dragged into this conflict and the Soviet Union is infamous for fielding large amounts of units. If Japan hasn't defeated all of its other enemies by this point, both of you will be in serious trouble. When taking the focus to declare independence from Japan, try to time it such that it will finish either before the Soviets finish the Far East Fortification focus, or after they complete the following one: Operation Zet. Between these two focuses, the Soviets will garrison Manchukuo's northern border, and the Japanese will divert troops to this border in turn. Once Operation Zet is completed, however, and the Soviets withdraw, Japan will return the troops on your northern border to the Chinese front line, handily reducing the number of fronts the player will need to fight on and eliminating the need to divert resources to hunting the Japanese in the north before they can eat too far into you from behind once the Independence War focus is done. To increase the chances of survival, Manchukuo should invest time and resources into fortifying its borders (both Soviet and Chinese borders) with land forts combined with anti-air emplacements. In order to maximize efficiency, you should build in layers. Queue up level 1 forts in every border province and, once those forts are completed, queue up upgrades to level 2 for every fort, and so on. Do not queue up a batch of level 10 right away as this makes each individual fort very time-consuming to build and slows down the entire project. Once you have built up forts, start constructing anti-air emplacements in every state. Forts will be of no use if the Soviets can dismantle them with an endless barrage of bombers.

Manchukuo starts off very weak economically, and it is required that Manchukuo focus on Industry and Electronic research early on alongside the associated National Focuses.

Although the player will likely be offered an invitation into the Chinese United Front, it is not recommended that they join, as doing so will make it so that Japan will only offer Nationalist China the offer to end the war. If they take the offer, the player will not receive any of the Chinese territory held by the Japanese after the White Peace is signed.
